intro: The PuraMax 2 identifies cats by weight rather than by camera and seals its base against leaks, so most of its specific questions are about telling cats apart, staying connected and keeping the base dry.

facts.text: Rated for cats from 3.3 to 22 lb. PETKIT advises against use by cats under six months.
Ships with 20 PETKIT trash bags and an N50 2.0 odour module.
A seamless ShieldBase seals the base, with an elastic-edged litter pad around it.

symptoms.title: Visits are logged to the wrong cat
symptoms.summary: The app mixes up which cat used the box.
causes: Identification is by weight, so cats of similar weight are hard to distinguish.

fixes.detail: If your cats weigh about the same, mix-ups are expected. Tag the ambiguous visits by hand in the app.

symptoms.escalate: If cats of clearly different weights are confused, work through the common weight steps, then contact PETKIT.

symptoms.title: It will not join the home network
symptoms.summary: Setup fails or the unit drops off the network.
causes: The PuraMax 2 only joins 2.4 GHz networks.

fixes.detail: Make sure it is pairing to a 2.4 GHz network. If your router merges both bands under one name, temporarily separate them or use a 2.4 GHz guest network.

symptoms.escalate: If it will not hold a 2.4 GHz connection close to the router, contact PETKIT.

symptoms.title: Moisture escapes around the edges
symptoms.summary: Liquid appears at the edges of the litter pad or around the base.
causes: The litter pad's elastic edges are not seated tightly.

fixes.detail: Refit the litter pad so its elastic edges grip firmly all the way round.

symptoms.escalate: If it leaks with the pad seated correctly, the ShieldBase seal may be damaged; contact PETKIT.
